summary: Copy a custom rootCA.crt into an execution environment by listing it in additional_build_files and, in prepend_base, COPY it to /usr/share/pki/ca-trust-source/anchors and RUN update-ca-trust so every build stage trusts it.
questions: How do I add a custom CA certificate to an execution environment?
How do I copy arbitrary files into an execution environment?

answer_card.title: Trust a custom CA in an execution environment
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
additional_build_files:
  - src: files/rootCA.crt
    dest: configs

additional_build_steps:
  prepend_base:
    - COPY _build/configs/rootCA.crt /usr/share/pki/ca-trust-source/anchors
    - RUN update-ca-trust
```
Because it runs in `base`, all later stages and the final image trust the CA.
